@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M5QWHA34WP7DQMWQ4AHNB0J9
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8980'
+title: 'MTP: save and load the drafter state with PromptCacheSnapshot'
+---
+## What
+A session snapshot (`PromptCacheSnapshot`, `savePromptCache`, `loadPromptCache` in Libraries/MLXLMCommon/KVCache.swift ~2260-2400) holds only the main cache and the model state. A session restored from it with MTP has no drafter to reuse. Today ChatSession then drops speculation (`draftCacheIsRecoverable` ~1660).
+
+- [ ] Add an optional MTP drafter state to `PromptCacheSnapshot`. Write the drafter cache arrays, its offset, and the pending hidden row under reserved key prefixes (in the style of `__mlx_lm_state_` / `__mlx_lm_offset_`), and read them back in `loadPromptCache`.
+- [ ] Make the ChatSession snapshot export and the `init(_:promptCache:speculativeDecoding:...)` initializers (ChatSession.swift ~842-885) carry the drafter state. A session restored with an MTP config must reuse the drafter without a new prefill.
+- [ ] Make sure that old snapshot files, which have no drafter keys, still load. Then the drafter is rebuilt.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Save a session snapshot, load it, and continue with MTP: the text is the same as with no save/load, and the drafter is reused (no drafter feed over the cached prefix).
+- [ ] A snapshot written before this change loads, and generation is correct.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests: a `savePromptCache` / `loadPromptCache` round-trip unit test with the drafter keys, and a test with an old-format file.
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests: a ChatSession snapshot round-trip test on the scripted Qwen35 + MTP fixture.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #chat-session
\ No newline at end of file
